notes: Exercises the repo's %rm_design (PROC TABULATE design overview) and %sw_cont_descrip (PROC MEANS / SGPANEL / TABULATE descriptives for a repeated-measures continuous outcome) macros, taken verbatim from its200124.sas. The repo's own driver reads an external dataset via placeholder names; this caller supplies a small stepped-wedge mock (2 centers, 12 periods, 4 subjects per cluster-period, seeded rand) that satisfies the cluster/period/trt/outcome contract the macros expect. exit_code=1 is a benign cosmetic axis-option warning; the descriptive output is complete.
